conventions.label: The repository's rules
conventions.hint: where the repository writes its conventions, and the skills it stores — an engine only reads the file of its own family

product.label: What the product does
product.hint: the sentence declared for reading changes — without it, an agent only talks about the code

lessons.label: The project notebook
lessons.hint: what has already had to be redone by hand, filtered on the files at stake

place.label: The branch and its state
place.hint: base, divergence, uncommitted files, latest commits — read from the repository, always available

ticket.label: The branch's ticket
ticket.hint: the request and its comments, from the declared tracker

review.label: Review feedback
review.hint: description and discussion of the merge request opened on this branch

attempts.label: What has already been tried
attempts.hint: past conversations in this folder, one line each

errors.alreadyRunning: An analysis of this change is already running.
errors.changeGone: This change no longer exists: the pull request was closed, or the branch is gone.
errors.noWorkdir: No folder for the agent to work in.

interrupted.label: Reading interrupted by the cockpit closing
interrupted.detail: The agent running it stops with the application. Restart it from the Impact screen.

errors.noneDeclared: This project has not declared any properties. Write what must stay true in Settings → Agents, or ask the cockpit to suggest some based on your own fixes.
errors.noneApplicable: None of the declared properties concern the files in this change.
errors.noWorkdir: No folder for the agents to work in.
errors.repoMissing: This project's main repository cannot be found on this machine.
errors.noFixesCalibration: No identifiable fix in the last four hundred commits. Calibration relies on commits that fix something: without them, nothing tells whether this property can fail.
errors.noFixesSuggest: No identifiable fix in the recent history: nothing to build on to suggest properties specific to this repository.
errors.nothingUsable: The agent suggested nothing usable. Try again, or write the first property yourself.

closed.suspended: Suspended. Running engagements finish; no new one starts.
closed.capped: Daily cap reached. It will start again tomorrow.
closed.quota: Shared quota below the floor: it leaves room for you.
closed.tripped: Circuit breaker: too many failures in a row. It stopped itself.

journal.ruleAwaiting: rule “{{rule}}” — the plan awaits your approval

halt.cannotStop: {{kind}} · {{what}} — the cockpit does not know how to stop it

undo.nothingProduced: Nothing was produced: there is nothing to undo.
undo.cannotUndo: The cockpit does not know how to undo: {{items}}. To be handled by hand.
undo.cannotUndoKind: {{kind}} · {{what}} — the cockpit does not know how to undo it

cannotOpen.running: an engagement is already running ({{max}} at most at a time)
cannotOpen.quarantined: this item was just handled; it is left alone for {{hours}} h

oracle.none: No oracle declared: nothing can tell whether the goal is reached.
oracle.unknownKind: The cockpit does not know how to query an oracle of type “{{kind}}”.
oracle.commandGone: The command “{{id}}” is no longer declared in this repository.
oracle.commandSensitive: “{{name}}” is marked sensitive: it cannot serve as proof. Checking must not change anything.
oracle.noRepo: No local repository to run the command in.
oracle.changeGone: This change no longer exists: it was merged or closed.
oracle.noGithubAccount: The GitHub account could not be determined (`gh` missing or not signed in).
oracle.commented: A comment from {{me}} was posted on #{{number}}.
oracle.propertyNotApplicable: The property “{{id}}” does not apply to this change.

errors.notPullRequest: This change is not a pull request.

engagement.noNode: Node cannot be found: the agent could not declare its intent, and a plan read from text is not a plan.
engagement.noIntent: The agent declared no intent. Without a statable goal, nothing goes out.
engagement.openMissionWhy: code must be written: the work will go through a mission
engagement.rehearsed: Rehearsal: the plan is written, nothing was done.
engagement.missionNotAllowed: Code would have had to be written, and “open a mission” is not in the allow list. Nothing was done.
engagement.sharedBranch: The integration branch would be “{{branch}}”, which is shared. Nothing was done.
engagement.awaitingApprovalWhy: this rule asks for the human gate again: the plan is waiting
engagement.missionFailed: The mission could not be opened: {{error}}
engagement.resolvedWithoutActs: {{why}} No action was requested: the situation resolved without it.
engagement.resolvedAllRefused: {{why}} No action could be taken: it was not what settled this.
engagement.missionGone: The mission has disappeared: impossible to say what became of it.

acts.notAllowed: “{{power}}” is not in the allow list: the action was not taken.
acts.sharedBranch: “{{branch}}” is a shared branch: the Permanence never writes to it. It only works on branches of its own.
acts.noBranch: Cannot find the branch of this change.
acts.commandSensitive: “{{name}}” is marked sensitive: it does not run without you.
acts.sharedBranchName: “{{name}}” is a shared branch name: it will not take it.
acts.sharedWorktree: “{{branch}}” is a shared branch: it does not check it out as a worktree, otherwise an agent would write to it at the next action.
acts.worktreeByAgent: Worktree creation goes through an agent command: it needs someone present.
acts.noWorktree: The branch “{{branch}}” is not checked out as a worktree: an agent started in the main repository would write where you are working.
acts.needsApp: Starting an agent needs the application: it does not start from a test bench.
acts.unknown: The cockpit does not know how to perform “{{tool}}”.

comment.disabled: The power to comment is not enabled.
comment.noScopes: No condition is checked: it comments nowhere, by design.
comment.noCondition: No condition is true on #{{number}}: it is not allowed to write there.
